title: Great Western Air Ambulance Charity announces new chief executive
summary: With a background that spans over 20 years in healthcare, Evans brings experience of leading services, developing partnerships, and helping organizations grow their reach and impact.
body_markdown:
Great Western Air Ambulance Charity (GWAAC) is delighted to announce the appointment of its new chief executive officer, Emily Evans.


Emily officially takes up the role on 4 January 2027. She will be leading GWAAC, the air ambulance and critical care service for Bath and North East Somerset, Bristol, South Gloucestershire, Gloucestershire, North Somerset, and parts of Wiltshire, into its next chapter from the New Year.


With a background that spans over 20 years in healthcare, Emily brings experience of leading services, developing partnerships, and helping organizations grow their reach and impact.


Most recently, she has been part of the executive team at Everyturn Mental Health, a national charity supporting over[90](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/rotor+x/90) ,000 people annually. During her time there, the charity significantly increased income and expanded its services, enabling them to support many more people and communities.


**Why Emily is joining GWAAC**


Emily says: “I’ve always been motivated by opportunities to help organisations grow and increase their impact. The chance to lead a charity making such an extraordinary difference, in a region I’m incredibly proud to call home, was an opportunity I couldn’t resist.


GWAAC has an exceptional clinical service, a passionate team, and a wonderful community of supporters. I believe there’s huge potential to build on those foundations, reaching more people, and growing the support that makes our lifesaving work possible.”


**On starting the role**


“I’m really looking forward to spending time with our crew, colleagues, and volunteers, hearing their experiences and understanding more about what makes GWAAC so special. I’m equally excited about getting out into our communities, meeting patients and their families, and getting to know the incredible people and organisations who support the charity.”


**A welcome from GWAAC’s Chair of the Board of Trustees**


Jason Holt says: “As Chair of the Board of Trustees at Great Western Air Ambulance Charity (GWAAC), I am delighted to welcome Emily as our new Chief Executive Officer.


Emily brings a wealth of experience from her previous roles across healthcare, mental health, and charity sectors. The combination of her strategic vision and strong track record of operational delivery, organisational growth and cultural transformation will be particularly valuable to GWAAC.


During the recruitment process, the Board were particularly impressed by Emily’s collaborative people-focused leadership style underpinned by a clear commitment to fostering a strong and positive organisational culture. We are confident she will provide the strong direction needed as we look ahead to the charity’s next chapter.”


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Great Western Air Ambulance Charity*
